description.p: CrunchySFX is a from-scratch sound-effect generator in the sfxr/bfxr tradition, but far beyond classic chiptune: 15+ hand-written synthesis engines (subtractive, FM & 4-operator FM, Karplus-Strong pluck, modal/bell resonators, granular, a formant vocal model with text-to-speech, additive pads, impact/whoosh/particle foley, and a draw-your-own wavetable), 600+ presets, one-click WAV export, procedural breeding, and a Foundry that generates and re-voices sounds on retro console chips.
Every sound is synthesized — no sample libraries, no AI models, no cloud. Sounds you create are public domain (CC0 1.0): use them for anything, commercial or not, with no attribution, forever.
